name: Prescription Renewal Response
sourceRefs: cosyte/ncpdp src/script/lifecycle.ts — RxRenewalResponse extends LifecycleResponseFields with ZERO additional fields of its own; detectOutcome()'s OUTCOME_ELEMENTS constant is shared verbatim across RxRenewalResponse/RxChangeResponse/CancelRxResponse (same 6 outcome elements, same fail-safe denial-first precedence order) — the exact same shape already built and verified for CancelRxResponse/RxChangeResponse (see those files' own sourceRefs). DenyNewToFollow is semantically most natural for a RENEWAL response specifically ("denied, a new prescription will follow separately" — cosyte's own doc comment) but the type is shared identically across all 3 lifecycle response kinds, so it is modeled here unchanged rather than renamed.

medicationPrescribed's presence/placement for an ApprovedWithChanges outcome carries the same not-fully-confirmed caveat already noted in CancelRxResponse.json/RxChangeResponse.json — modeled as a top-level optional field per the same source.

CORRECTED 2026-09-19: the 6 outcome groups moved from direct children of RxRenewalResponse to nested one level deeper inside the shared `ResponseWrapper` group (xmlElement 'Response') — see ResponseWrapper.json's own sourceRefs for the full real-fixture-driven correction record (found via 6 real rxrenewal-response-*.xml fixtures, every one nesting its own outcome under `<Response>`).
